description:
Port 4 lifecycle extensions:
- trigger-compact.ts → TriggerCompact: turn_end handler, ctx.getContextUsage, ctx.compact
- custom-compaction.ts → CustomCompaction: session_before_compact handler, LLM-based summarization
- auto-commit-on-exit.ts → AutoCommitOnExit: session_shutdown handler, git operations
- git-checkpoint.ts → GitCheckpoint: turn_end handler, automatic git stash/checkpoint

Exercises lifecycle events, context usage APIs, and the compaction extension points.
title: Example extensions wave 3: lifecycle & compaction (trigger-compact, custom-compaction, auto-commit-on-exit, git-checkpoint)
